[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Return windows

- **Unopened products:** you can return them within **30 days** of delivery for a full refund.
- **Opened products in perfect condition:** you can return them within **14 days** of delivery. The product must include all original accessories, manuals and packaging.
- **Defective products:** if a product stops working within the first **30 days**, we replace it or refund it in full, whether it was opened or not. After 30 days, defects are handled under the warranty policy.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Exchanges

You can exchange a product for a different model or colour within the same return window. If the new product costs more, you pay the difference; if it costs less, we refund the difference.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > How to start a return

1. Open **My Orders** in your account and select the order.
2. Choose **Request Return**, pick the items and the reason.
3. Our team reviews the request within **2 business days**.
4. Once approved, a courier collects the item from your address for free (Cairo and Giza) or you can drop it at any ShopMind branch.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy

At ShopMind Electronics we want you to be happy with every purchase. This policy explains when and how you can return a product and how refunds are paid.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Products that cannot be returned

- Items sold in the **Clearance** section are final sale and cannot be returned unless they are defective.
- Opened software, gift cards, and digital licence codes.
- In-ear headphones and earbuds once the hygiene seal is broken, unless they are defective.
- Products damaged by misuse, liquid, drops, or unauthorised repair.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Refunds

- Refunds go back to the **original payment method**.
- Card payments: **5 to 10 business days** after we receive and inspect the item.
- Cash on delivery orders: refunded to a ShopMind wallet within **2 business days**, or by bank transfer within **7 business days** if you request it.
- Shipping fees are refunded only when the return is due to our error or a defective product.

d1.answer:
14 days. Opened products in perfect condition can be returned within 14 days of delivery, with all original accessories, manuals and packaging [POL-001]. (Unopened items get 30 days, and a defective product is covered for 30 days whether opened or not [POL-001].)

Note: clearance items are final sale unless defective, and earbuds/in-ear headphones can't be returned once the hygiene seal is broken unless defective [POL-001].

[POL-002] Shipping and Delivery Policy
Shipping and Delivery Policy > Shipping fees

- **Free standard shipping** on orders of **2,000 EGP or more** to Cairo and Giza.
- Standard shipping to Cairo and Giza for smaller orders: **50 EGP**.
- Standard shipping to all other governorates: **75 EGP**, free on orders of **5,000 EGP or more**.
- Express delivery: **120 EGP**, never free.
- Large items (TVs over 55 inches, gaming chairs) have a fixed fee of **150 EGP** outside Cairo and Giza.

[POL-006] Order Cancellation Policy
Order Cancellation Policy > Partial cancellation

For orders with several items, you can cancel individual items before the order ships. Free shipping is recalculated: if the remaining total drops below the free shipping threshold, the standard fee is added.

[POL-002] Shipping and Delivery Policy
Shipping and Delivery Policy > Failed delivery

The courier tries to deliver **twice**. If both attempts fail, the order returns to our warehouse and is cancelled. Prepaid orders are refunded minus the shipping fee.

[POL-002] Shipping and Delivery Policy
Shipping and Delivery Policy > Delivery areas and times

| Area | Standard delivery | Express delivery |
|---|---|---|
| Cairo and Giza | 1 to 2 business days | Same day (order before 2 PM) |
| Alexandria, Delta and Canal cities | 2 to 4 business days | Next business day |
| Upper Egypt, Red Sea and Sinai | 3 to 6 business days | Not available |  
Business days are Sunday to Thursday, excluding public holidays.

[POL-006] Order Cancellation Policy
Order Cancellation Policy > Cancelling before shipping

You can cancel an order for free while its status is **Pending** or **Confirmed**. Open My Orders and choose **Cancel Order**. Prepaid orders are refunded in full to the original payment method.

d2.answer:
Shipping to Alexandria is **75 EGP** standard, and it's **free on orders of 5,000 EGP or more** [POL-002].

A couple of extras:
- Express delivery to Alexandria is 120 EGP and is never free [POL-002].
- Standard delivery to Alexandria takes 2 to 4 business days (Sunday to Thursday, excluding public holidays) [POL-002].

Note: the 2,000 EGP free-shipping threshold only applies to Cairo and Giza, not Alexandria [POL-002].

[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > What the warranty covers

Manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship under normal use: for example a phone that does not charge, a laptop with a dead keyboard, or headphones with one silent side.

[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > ShopMind Care+ (extended warranty)

You can add **ShopMind Care+** at checkout to extend the warranty by **12 months** and add one accidental damage repair (screen or liquid). Care+ costs **8% of the product price** and must be bought with the product or within 7 days of delivery.

[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > Warranty length

- Every product sold by ShopMind has an official warranty. The warranty length is written on each product page and on the invoice.
- Phones, laptops, tablets and TVs: usually **12 to 24 months** of manufacturer warranty.
- Accessories (chargers, cables, cases): **6 months** of ShopMind warranty.
- Products in the Clearance section keep their manufacturer warranty, but ShopMind's extra warranty does not apply.

[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > What the warranty does not cover

- Physical damage: cracked screens, dents, bent ports.
- Liquid damage, even on water-resistant devices.
- Battery wear after 12 months (battery capacity naturally drops over time).
- Software problems caused by unofficial software, rooting or jailbreaking.
- Damage from repairs done outside an authorised service centre.

[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > How to make a warranty claim

1. Keep your invoice; you can download it any time from **My Orders**.
2. Request a warranty service from the order page or visit any ShopMind branch.
3. We inspect the device within **3 business days** and send it to the authorised service centre if needed.
4. Typical repair time is **7 to 14 business days**. If the same defect happens **three times**, we replace the device.

d4.answer:
The warranty does **not** cover [POL-003]:

- Physical damage — cracked screens, dents, bent ports
- Liquid damage, even on water-resistant devices
- Battery wear after 12 months (normal capacity drop)
- Software problems caused by unofficial software, rooting or jailbreaking
- Damage from repairs done outside an authorised service centre

What it **does** cover: manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship under normal use — e.g. a phone that won't charge, a dead laptop keyboard, or headphones with one silent side [POL-003].

Tip: you can add ShopMind Care+ at checkout (8% of the product price) to extend the warranty by 12 months and get one accidental damage repair (screen or liquid) [POL-003].

[FAQ-008] Where are your branches?
Where are your branches?

ShopMind has five branches: **Nasr City** (City Stars Mall), **Sheikh Zayed** (Arkan Plaza), **Maadi** (Road 9), **Alexandria** (San Stefano Mall) and **Mansoura** (El Gomhoreya Street). All branches open daily from **10 AM to 11 PM**, and Friday from **2 PM to 11 PM**.

[FAQ-007] Can I pick up my order from a branch?
Can I pick up my order from a branch?

Yes. Choose **Store Pickup** at checkout and select a branch. Pickup is free. You will get an SMS when the order is ready, usually within **24 hours** in Cairo and Giza branches. Bring your ID and the order number. Orders not collected within **7 days** are cancelled and refunded.

[FAQ-010] Do you offer trade-in for old phones?
Do you offer trade-in for old phones?

Yes. With **ShopMind Trade-In** you can trade your old smartphone or laptop for a discount on a new device. Bring the device to any branch for a free check; the trade-in value depends on the model, condition and battery health. The value is applied immediately as a discount on your new purchase. Trade-in is available in branches only, not online.

[FAQ-003] Do you deliver outside Egypt?
Do you deliver outside Egypt?

No. ShopMind currently delivers only inside Egypt, to all 27 governorates. Delivery times and fees depend on the area; see the Shipping and Delivery Policy.

[FAQ-009] How do I contact customer support?
How do I contact customer support?

You can chat with us on the website or app (24/7 AI assistant, human agents from 9 AM to 11 PM), call **19555**, or email **support@shopmind.example**. For faster help, have your order number ready.

ShopMind Points > Earning points

- You earn **1 point for every 10 EGP** spent on delivered orders.
- Points are added **14 days after delivery** (after the return window for opened products ends).
- Gold members (spent 100,000 EGP or more in the last 12 months) earn **double points**.

[POL-009] Loyalty Program: ShopMind Points
ShopMind Points > Using points

- **100 points = 10 EGP** discount at checkout.
- You can pay up to **30%** of an order with points.
- Points expire **12 months** after they are earned.

[POL-009] Loyalty Program: ShopMind Points
ShopMind Points > Returns

If you return a product, the points earned from it are removed. Points used on a returned order are given back to your account.

[POL-007] Price Match Guarantee
Price Match Guarantee > Conditions

- The product must be identical: same brand, model, storage, colour and condition (new).
- The competitor must be an authorised dealer with the product in stock and delivery available in Egypt.
- Prices from marketplaces with third-party sellers, auctions, flash sales, coupon codes and bundle offers are excluded.
- The difference is refunded to your ShopMind wallet.

[POL-007] Price Match Guarantee
Price Match Guarantee

If you find the same product cheaper at an authorised Egyptian retailer within **7 days** of your purchase, we refund the difference.

d7.answer:

- 1 point for every 10 EGP spent on delivered orders.
- Points are added 14 days after delivery (once the return window for opened products ends).
- Gold members (100,000 EGP+ spent in the last 12 months) earn double points.

**Value & use**
- 100 points = 10 EGP discount at checkout.
- You can pay up to 30% of an order with points.
- Points expire 12 months after they're earned.

**Returns**
- If you return a product, the points earned from it are removed, and any points you used on that order go back to your account. [POL-009]
